Data Engineering 2026-10-28

⬛ Overview · 🟪 AI Agents · 🟦 AI Models & Labs · 🟧 AI Policy · 🟨 Data Engineering

Vendor items: 12 | Projects: 17 | Active today: 0 | Stable releases: 0 | Prereleases (not covered): 0 | Generated: 2026-10-28 05:25 UTC

Highlights

  • Azure Databricks account admins: account-level security features (network connectivity, network security, encryption, enhanced compliance) are now GA by default; configure them before they take effect.
  • Snowflake users building ingestion pipelines: CoCo is GA for continuous Snowpipe loads on new files and one-time COPY INTO on existing files, targeting standard or Snowflake-managed tables.
  • Databricks metastore admins: AI Functions Unity Catalog permissions on system.ai schema are GA; enablement requires contacting your Databricks account team.

Databricks

Date Item Summary
2026-10-27 🤖 Default OAuth apps for external AI agents are now generally available ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, Claude Code, and Cursor can connect to Azure Databricks MCP servers including the Genie One MCP server using default OAuth client IDs, removing the need for account admins to create an OAuth app.
2026-10-27 Editing files in Unity Catalog volumes is now generally available Files in Unity Catalog volumes can be edited directly in the workspace file editor without download or re-upload, accessible from Catalog Explorer or the schema browser in a notebook or SQL editor.
2026-10-27 🤖 AI Functions Unity Catalog permissions is now generally available Metastore admins can control which task-specific AI Functions users can run via Unity Catalog permissions on the system.ai schema, though enabling the feature requires contacting your Databricks account team.
2026-10-26 Account-level security features are now available by default at GA Account-level security features for network connectivity, network security, encryption, and enhanced security and compliance are available by default at GA without manual enablement on the Previews page, but account admins must configure them before they take effect and retain full control over adoption.

Quiet today: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Databricks CLI, dbt-databricks

Snowflake

Date Item Summary
2026-10-27 Continuous and bulk file loading with CoCo (General availability) CoCo builds continuous Snowpipe pipelines for new files in cloud storage or one-time COPY INTO loads for existing files, both loading into standard Snowflake tables or Snowflake-managed tables.
2026-10-27 🤖 Cortex Code skills for interactive analytics Two Cortex Code skills now help work with interactive analytics in Snowflake.
2026-10-26 Secondary indexes (General availability) —

Quiet today: Snowpark Python, Snowflake Connector for Python, Apache Polaris

Azure / Fabric & GCP

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-27 BigQuery Feature: You can manage and version control SQL scripts and notebooks with BigQuery Studio Git repositories, which provide a streamlined, folder-based integration with remote Git repositories. SQL scripts and notebooks can be version controlled with BigQuery Studio Git repositories, providing a streamlined folder-based integration with remote Git repositories.
2026-10-27 BigQuery 🤖 Feature: The Data Engineering Agent now integrates with Google Drive, letting you provide Google Sheets files, CSV, or JSONL files as input for your data engineering pipelines. The Data Engineering Agent integrates with Google Drive, accepting Google Sheets files, CSV, or JSONL files as input for data engineering pipelines.
2026-10-27 BigQuery 🤖 Feature: You can now use conversational analytics in Connected Sheets to ask questions and analyze your BigQuery data using natural language. Conversational analytics in Connected Sheets enables natural language questions on BigQuery data, with the Gemini side panel translating to optimized SQL, executing queries, summarizing trends, and inserting live refreshable database objects into workbooks.
2026-10-27 Azure updates [Launched] Generally Available: Higher limit of Azure Blob Storage accounts per region per subscription Azure Blob Storage accounts per region per subscription now support up to 1,000 storage accounts with standard endpoints, up from the default 250, enabling more accounts per subscription.
2026-10-21 Microsoft Fabric Simplify Teradata migrations with Fabric Migration Assistant (Preview) Fabric Migration Assistant for Data Warehouse supports Teradata sources in preview, converting eligible metadata and code to Fabric-compatible T-SQL, deploying destination definitions, and flagging scripts for review, though data migration requires a separate loading step.

Also new: Feature: The AI.COUNT_TOKENS function, which estimates the token count of a text string, is generally available (GA). · Connect coding agents to Fabric notebooks with FNTK (Preview)

Nothing new from Open-source stack (dbt Core, SQLMesh, Apache Airflow, Dagster, dlt, Apache Iceberg, DuckDB, Polars, Trino) today.

Across platforms

  • AI-assisted development and analytics moved on all three platforms: Databricks added default OAuth apps so ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, and Cursor connect to MCP servers (GA); Snowflake released Cortex Code skills for interactive analytics; BigQuery launched conversational analytics in Connected Sheets (natural language to optimized SQL via Gemini) and a Data Engineering Agent that accepts Google Drive files as pipeline input.
  • Git-backed authoring for SQL and notebooks appeared on BigQuery (BigQuery Studio Git repositories, folder-based remote repo integration); no equivalent GA item in this set for Databricks or Snowflake.

Data Engineering 2026-10-27

⬛ Overview · 🟪 AI Agents · 🟦 AI Models & Labs · 🟧 AI Policy · 🟨 Data Engineering

Generated: 2026-10-27 04:50 UTC | Vendor items: 12 | Projects: 17 | Active today: 3 | Stable releases: 2 | Prereleases (not covered): 0

Highlights

  • − Snowflake Connector for Python v4.8.1 drops Python 3.10 support (minimum now 3.11); Snowflake Python users on 3.10 must upgrade runtime before adopting this version.
  • Azure Databricks workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled will receive Lakeflow Performance Observability by default on 2026-11-25; no action required but expect job-level query metrics and Genie Code Optimize button to appear.
  • Snowflake Task Graphs Preview adds atomic deployments, centralized configuration, and upstream-outcome-based run control; teams orchestrating tasks in Snowflake should evaluate for CI/CD workflows.
  • Snowflake Pipeline Builder Preview provides a visual designer to orchestrate Notebooks, Python files, ML Jobs, and SQL as version-controlled task graphs; Snowflake-native pipeline authors should test the DCM-backed deployment model.
  • BigQuery Conversational Analytics conversation logging reaches GA; organizations using BigQuery data agents can now persist agent conversations to a BigQuery table in the agent's project.

Databricks

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-26 Azure Databricks 🤖 Improved Lakeflow Performance Observability will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled Starting November 25, 2026, workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled get Lakeflow Performance Observability by default, providing job-level query metrics, data volume insights, and an Optimize button linking to Genie Code for serverless compute, SQL Warehouses, and Lakeflow Pipelines.
2026-10-26 Azure Databricks 🤖 Improved Lakeflow Performance Observability is now generally available Lakeflow Jobs now expose job-level query performance metrics and data volume insights with an Optimize button that opens Genie Code for query tuning on serverless compute.
2026-10-26 Azure Databricks QuickBooks connector is available in Beta The managed QuickBooks connector in Lakeflow Connect (Beta) ingests accounting data from QuickBooks Online via OAuth user authorization with incremental ingestion and delete capture.
2026-10-24 Azure Databricks PayPal connector is available in Beta The managed PayPal connector in Lakeflow Connect (Beta) ingests payments data from PayPal using OAuth client credentials with incremental ingestion.

Quiet today: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Databricks CLI, dbt-databricks

Snowflake

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-23 Snowflake Oct 23, 2026: Atomic deployments, centralized configuration, and advanced branching for task graphs (Preview) Preview adds centralized task graph configuration, atomic deployments without pipeline suspension, and upstream-outcome-based task run control.
2026-10-22 Snowflake Oct 22, 2026: Pipeline Builder (Preview) Pipeline Builder (Preview) provides a visual designer to orchestrate Notebooks, Python files, ML Jobs, and SQL as task graphs, with each pipeline as a DCM project enabling planned deployments and version control.
2026-10-22 Snowflake Oct 22, 2026: Ingress policies (Preview) Ingress policies (Preview) allow admitting or blocking requests by combining multiple conditions into a single policy.
2026-10-23 Snowflake Oct 23, 2026: CoCo Desktop v1.22.1 CoCo Desktop v1.22.1 adds Defer to Production for Snowflake-managed dbt runs and improves session and app management.

Snowflake Connector for Python

  • Release: v4.8.1 fixes write_pandas identifier quoting (Parquet field paths quoted, Iceberg option values escaped, quote_identifiers=False validates unquoted identifiers), drops Python 3.10 support (minimum now 3.11), and upgrades vendored urllib3 to 2.8.0.

Quiet today: Snowpark Python, Apache Polaris

Azure / Fabric & GCP

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-26 BigQuery 🤖 Feature: Conversation logging for Conversational analytics in BigQuery is now generally available (GA). Conversation logging for Conversational Analytics (GA) lets you log data agent conversations to a BigQuery table in the agent's project.
2026-10-26 BigQuery Feature: Python user-defined functions now support volume mounts, which let you access dependency files from Cloud Storage directly from your Python UDF code. Python UDFs (Preview) now support volume mounts to access dependency files directly from Cloud Storage.
2026-10-26 BigQuery Feature: The REGEXP_EXTRACT_GROUPS function produces substrings that match multiple capturing groups in a regular expression. The new REGEXP_EXTRACT_GROUPS function (Preview) extracts substrings matching multiple capturing groups in a regex.
2026-10-26 Microsoft Fabric Announcing workspace monitoring integration for Fabric Data Warehouse (Preview) Workspace monitoring integration (Preview) aggregates completed warehouse query events into a WarehouseExecutions table in a monitoring Eventhouse/KQL database, covering warehouses, SQL analytics endpoints, and snapshots with metrics like duration, status, result codes, and CPU time for cross-workspace performance analysis.

Open-source stack

Dagster

  • Release: 1.13.27 removes the default [Dagster Plus] Credit Limit Exceeded alert policy for new organizations, adds a mobile-friendly run details page, and scopes BigQuery Insights cost queries to the dbt invocation.

Polars

  • Hot issue: #30299 reports a regression in Polars 2.0 where streaming select reorders rows when using when(window).then(literal).otherwise(literal), marked high priority and now closed.

Quiet today: dbt Core, SQLMesh, Apache Airflow, dlt, Apache Iceberg, DuckDB, Trino

Across platforms

  • AI-assisted SQL optimization: Databricks (GA, Genie Code via Optimize button in Lakeflow Observability for serverless, SQL Warehouses, Lakeflow Pipelines) and BigQuery (GA, Conversational Analytics with conversation logging to BigQuery tables).
  • Warehouse query observability: Databricks (GA, Lakeflow Performance Observability with job-level query metrics and data volume insights) and Microsoft Fabric (Preview, Workspace monitoring integration aggregating completed warehouse query events into a WarehouseExecutions KQL table).

Highlights

  • Azure Databricks workspaces with Unity Catalog volumes: Files API 3.0 (Beta) enables multipart uploads over 5 GB and conditional operations; test large-file and versioned workflows.
  • Azure Databricks workspaces using serverless compute: Serverless job environments from pyproject.toml (Beta) requires enabling Project‑Scoped Shared Compute on the Previews page; configure job environments via pyproject.toml in Jobs UI, API, or bundles.
  • Azure Databricks workspaces using Asset Bundles: Shared Serverless for Asset Bundles (Beta) requires enabling Project‑Scoped Shared Compute; notebooks and files in the same bundle can share serverless compute and a bundle‑root pyproject.toml environment.
  • Snowflake on GCP clients using Snowpark Container Services: GEN_ARM_G1 and GEN_X64_G1 instance families (1–28 vCPU) are now GA; migrate workloads to the new general‑purpose instances.
  • Snowflake clients running ML Jobs on Container Runtime: Custom runtime images (GA) let you build, validate, and register custom container images as Custom Runtime Environments; register images for production ML workloads.

Databricks

Date Source Item Summary

2026-10-23 Azure Databricks Google Analytics Aggregated connector is available in Beta Enables ingesting aggregated Google Analytics 4 report data into Azure Databricks via Lakeflow Connect with incremental ingestion and service account or OAuth U2M authentication; workspace admins control access via the Previews page.
2026-10-22 Azure Databricks Serverless job environments from pyproject.toml (Beta) Allows serverless notebook and Python script tasks to configure job environments via pyproject.toml in the Jobs UI, API, or bundles; requires enabling Project‑Scoped Shared Compute on the Previews page.
2026-10-22 Azure Databricks Shared Serverless for Asset Bundles (Beta) Allows notebooks and files in the same asset bundle to share serverless compute and a bundle‑root pyproject.toml environment; requires enabling Project‑Scoped Shared Compute on the Previews page.

2026-10-22 Azure Databricks 🤖 Dashboard enhancements Adds private bookmarks for dashboard viewers, bulk import of up to 100 Power BI or Tableau files as AI/BI dashboards, field picker tooltips, layered combo charts, custom waterfall totals, and improved Sankey labels.

Highlights

  • Snowflake accounts in AWS US East 1 using Cortex fine-tuning — migrate new model training workloads to other regions; creation stopped October 20, 2026.

  • Azure Databricks workspaces with the compliance security profile — plan for Genie Code tasks in Lakeflow Jobs to be enabled by default starting November 2026.
  • Snowpark Python users calling DataFrame.to_polars() — upgrade to v1.55.3; method is now GA with Parquet default transport (performance shift) and JDBC lazy execution fix.
  • Azure Databricks users on serverless compute (env v5+, Connect Python 18.1.8+/Scala 18.1.5+) — validate df.cache()/persist() in Public Preview (on by default; admins can disable).

Highlights

  • DuckDB v2.0.0 "Cyanoptera" introduces a major internal overhaul converting identifiers to a dedicated class and adopting tidy-check tooling.
  • Polars read_csv exhibits a 120× memory overhead on wide tables in the v2 series, a severe performance regression under triage.
  • Snowflake Declarative Feature Store reaches general availability with version-controlled YAML or Python definitions and plan-and-apply deployment.
  • Azure Databricks enables native Postgres logical replication to stream changes into and out of Lakebase for migrations and continuous sync.
  • Azure Databricks adds OAuth custom identity claims to service principal tokens for row-level filtering in multi-tenant scenarios.

Databricks

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-16 Azure Databricks File upload in Genie One and Genie Agents will soon be available by default for compliance security profile workspaces with supported compliance standards Starting November 15, 2026, file upload in Genie One and Genie Agents becomes available by default for compliance security profile workspaces where the compliance standard supports it, enabling natural language analysis of uploaded files alongside existing data.
2026-10-15 Azure Databricks Replicate data in and out of Lakebase with Postgres logical replication Native Postgres logical replication now supports streaming changes into and out of Lakebase, allowing migration of existing Postgres databases and continuous sync with external Postgres instances.
2026-10-19 Azure Databricks Saving an unchanged job no longer adds rows to the jobs system tables Saving a job without changes no longer writes rows to system.lakeflow.jobs or system.lakeflow.job_tasks, and change_time remains at the last actual modification, reducing audit noise across UI, API, and bundle deployments.
2026-10-19 Azure Databricks Filter data per end user with OAuth custom identity claims Custom identity claims can now be added to service principal OAuth tokens and used for row-level filtering in dynamic views or ABAC policies, enabling multi-tenant data access through a single service principal.
2026-10-16 Azure Databricks Delegate budget access with access control lists (ACLs) Budgets now support access control lists (ACLs), allowing account and workspace admins to delegate Budget Manager or Budget Viewer roles to users, groups, or service principals for granular cost governance.
2026-10-16 Azure Databricks Delegate access to Genie budgets Genie cost budgets now support ACLs, letting admins assign Budget Manager or Budget Viewer roles to specific principals for delegated management of Genie spending limits.

Overview

MLflow shipped a patch release that adds lineage tracking for generative AI evaluation runs and fixes two tracking-related bugs affecting Optuna integration. The update improves reproducibility for hyperparameter tuning workloads and ensures dataset, scorer, and agent metadata are recorded during mlflow.genai.evaluate calls. No other Databricks-maintained projects reported releases, hot issues, or notable news in the last 24 hours.

MLflow

  • Release: v3.17.2 adds lineage recording for dataset, scorer, and agent metadata on mlflow.genai.evaluate runs, and fixes two tracking issues: reseeding sampler and forwarding batch settings on MlflowSparkStudy executors, plus preventing MlflowStorage from marking Optuna trials finished prematurely. v3.17.2

Snowflake

2026-10-20 Snowflake Oct 20, 2026: Sensitive Data Entitlement and Access reports (General availability) Sensitive Data Entitlement and Access reports in Trust Center are generally available for Enterprise Edition and higher, providing visibility into sensitive data access and entitlements.

Azure / Fabric & GCP

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-21 BigQuery Feature: The AI.CHUNK_DOCUMENT function is a table-valued function that splits unstructured documents into semantically coherent text chunks optimized for vector embeddings and Retrieval-Augmented Gen… BigQuery's AI.CHUNK_DOCUMENT function is generally available, splitting unstructured documents into semantically coherent chunks optimized for vector embeddings and RAG workflows.
2026-10-20 Microsoft Fabric New analytical functions in Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse (Preview) Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse preview adds MEDIAN, QUANTILE, APPROX_MEDIAN, APPROX_QUANTILE, and aggregate syntax for PERCENTILE_CONT/DISC, enabling efficient distribution analytics in T-SQL.
2026-10-21 Azure updates [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB Safe Key Rotation Azure Cosmos DB Safe Key Rotation is generally available, providing last-used timestamps for account keys to safely identify active keys before rotating or retiring credentials.

Open-source stack

Overview

DuckDB released version 2.0.0 "Cyanoptera", a major milestone that refactors internal identifiers and adopts tidy-check tooling. Polars users are reporting a severe memory regression in read_csv on wide tables, with the function consuming 120× more data memory than expected in the v2 series.

DuckDB

  • Release: DuckDB v2.0.0 "Cyanoptera" introduces a major internal overhaul, converting Identifier from strings to a dedicated class and migrating to tidy-check for development workflows. The release marks a significant architectural step for the engine. https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/releases/tag/v2.0.0

Polars

  • Hot issue: read_csv exhibits a 120× memory overhead on wide tables in Polars v2, flagged as a performance regression with medium priority. The issue is accepted and under triage, affecting Python users processing broad datasets. https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/30114

Quiet today: dbt Core, SQLMesh, Apache Airflow, Dagster, dlt, Apache Iceberg, Trino

Data × AI

  • Azure Databricks will enable file upload in Genie One and Genie Agents by default for compliance security profile workspaces, allowing natural language analysis of uploaded files.
  • Azure Databricks adds ACL-based delegation for Genie budgets so admins can assign Budget Manager or Budget Viewer roles to specific principals.
  • BigQuery releases AI.CHUNK_DOCUMENT as a generally available table-valued function that splits documents into chunks optimized for vector embeddings and RAG workflows.

Worth a Look

  • Saving an unchanged job no longer adds rows to the jobs system tables — Saving a job without changes no longer writes to system tables, reducing audit noise across UI, API, and bundle deployments.
  • New analytical functions in Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse (Preview) — Preview adds MEDIAN, QUANTILE, APPROX_MEDIAN, APPROX_QUANTILE, and PERCENTILE_CONT/DISC aggregate syntax for efficient distribution analytics.
  • Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB Safe Key Rotation — Provides last-used timestamps for account keys to safely identify active keys before rotating or retiring credentials.

📅 Overview · 🤖 AI Agents · 💬 AI Discussions · 📚 AI Research · 🌐 Lab Announcements · ⚖️ Policy Watch · 🗄️ Data Engineering Watch

Generated: 2026-10-20 01:42 UTC | Projects: 17 | Active today: 0 | Stable releases: 0 | Prereleases (not covered): 0

Highlights

  • Microsoft Fabric retires the Foundry data‑agent custom tool, requiring migration to Fabric IQ.
  • Snowflake’s Online Feature Store reaches general availability, enabling low‑latency feature serving for ML workloads.
  • Databricks releases the agentic code converter for general availability, supporting SQL conversion from T‑SQL, Snowflake, Redshift, Oracle, BigQuery and Teradata with validation and Genie Code chat.
  • Databricks makes on‑demand state repartitioning generally available, allowing dynamic resizing of shuffle partitions in Structured Streaming or Lakeflow without losing checkpoint state.

Databricks

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-15 Azure Databricks The agentic code converter is generally available for SQL conversion The agentic code converter is now generally available for converting SQL from dialects such as T‑SQL, Snowflake, Redshift, Oracle, BigQuery and Teradata into Databricks SQL queries, with validation and error fixing before writing results to a workspace folder. After conversion you can continue chatting with Genie Code about the converted files.
2026-10-13 Azure Databricks On-demand state repartitioning is now generally available On‑demand state repartitioning is now generally available, allowing you to resize the number of shuffle partitions for a stateful Structured Streaming query or Lakeflow pipeline without losing checkpoint state. This provides flexibility to scale streaming workloads while preserving state.
2026-10-13 Azure Databricks AI Runtime will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled AI Runtime is scheduled to become generally available on October 15, 2026 on AWS and Azure for workspaces without the compliance security profile enabled, and will be available by default for eligible workspaces with the compliance profile enabled in mid‑November. This lets you train and fine‑tune models on serverless GPUs without provisioning or managing the underlying infrastructure.
2026-10-14 Azure Databricks Workspace-level package repositories for Databricks Apps will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled Starting November 13, 2026, workspace‑level package repositories for Databricks Apps will be automatically enabled for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled, letting admins configure default Python and npm package repositories that apps inherit while still permitting app‑level overrides. This simplifies dependency management for Databricks Apps in compliant environments.
2026-10-15 Azure Databricks Context-based ingress policies for inbound private connectivity are now generally available Context‑based ingress policies for inbound Private Link are now generally available, enabling you to control which registered private endpoints can reach your workspace and combine endpoint rules with identity and request type conditions in a single policy. Account admins must turn on Context‑Based Ingress: Workspace Private Access Policies from the account console Previews page to use them.
2026-10-15 Azure Databricks Consumer access to query Unity Gateway services is generally available Consumer access to query Unity Gateway services is now generally available, so users with the consumer access entitlement no longer need an account admin to enable the preview to query model services or use Unity Gateway coding agent features. This can increase model traffic, and admins can set budgets, rate limits or disable direct model access for those users.

Snowflake

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-20 Snowflake October 20, 2026: Online Feature Store (General availability) Online Feature Store is now generally available and is no longer in Preview. Clients can use it for low‑latency feature serving in Snowflake ML workflows.
2026-10-13 Snowflake Oct 13, 2026: Cortex Agent SDK (Public Preview) The Cortex Agent SDK is now available in Public Preview for Python and TypeScript, allowing you to build applications that run Cortex Agents and Cortex Code, maintain conversations and threads, observe durable turns, and reconnect to long‑running work. This enables developers to create agent‑based solutions on Snowflake.
2026-10-13 Snowflake Oct 13, 2026: Gemini 4 Argon model in AI Functions (Preview) The gemini‑4‑argon model is now available in Public Preview in Snowflake AI Functions with the AICOMPLETE predicate. This gives you access to a newer Gemini model for AI‑driven SQL functions.

Azure / Fabric & GCP

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-19 Microsoft Fabric ⚠️ Retiring the Fabric data agent custom tool in Microsoft Foundry: move to Fabric IQ Starting November 6, 2026, the earlier Fabric data agent custom‑tool integration in Microsoft Foundry is deprecated and will no longer be supported; Foundry agents that use a Fabric data agent as a custom tool must be migrated before that date. The replacement integration uses the Fabric IQ (OneLake Catalog) tool to make Fabric data agents available to agents and applications.
2026-10-14 BigQuery Feature: Metadata migration from Dataproc Metastore to Lakehouse is now generally available (GA). Metadata migration from Dataproc Metastore to Lakehouse is now generally available, permitting a one‑time backfill or dry run to move metadata to an Apache Iceberg REST catalog endpoint or a Hive catalog endpoint via the Google Cloud console, gcloud CLI, or REST API. This simplifies lifting Dataproc Metastore metadata into a lakehouse storage format.
2026-10-14 BigQuery Feature: You can publish a BigQuery Conversational Analytics agent in Gemini Enterprise. You can now publish a BigQuery Conversational Analytics agent in Gemini Enterprise, a feature that is generally available. This lets you share conversational analytics capabilities as a managed agent within Gemini Enterprise.
2026-10-13 BigQuery Feature: The AI.AGG function is generally available (GA). The AI.AGG function is now generally available in BigQuery, enabling you to semantically aggregate unstructured input data based on natural language instructions. This provides a built‑in way to perform AI‑driven aggregation without custom code.

Data × AI

  • Databricks’ agentic code converter is now generally available for converting SQL from multiple dialects into Databricks SQL, with validation and chat‑based refinement via Genie Code.
  • Snowflake’s Cortex Agent SDK enters public preview for Python and TypeScript, enabling durable agent applications, and the Gemini 4 Argon model is previewed in AI Functions for AICOMPLETE.
  • BigQuery adds generally available AI.AGG for semantic aggregation and lets users publish Conversational Analytics agents in Gemini Enterprise, while Microsoft Fabric retires its Foundry data‑agent tool in favor of Fabric IQ.

Worth a Look

  • Microsoft Fabric’s retirement of the Foundry data‑agent tool – important for compliance‑focused environments needing to migrate to Fabric IQ.
  • Snowflake’s Online Feature Store GA – core for real‑time ML pipelines, worth understanding the new capabilities and limits.
  • Databricks agentic code converter GA – useful for cross‑platform SQL migration projects; review its validation and Genie Code interaction.
